title: Source-bound actor choices, finite scalar domains and sparse table updates
scope: Full labeled safety reachability from unmodified TLA+ and CFG. Eight Flint invariants and two action properties. No symmetry or graph replay. Every measured search starts a new process. The value blocks are an optional source-checkout worker.

inputs.Flint: ddalton/flint@8feba0c78f22e3ecdee0648c6b2897eac95ab1b4, lean/formal/LeanP1.tla. Recreate LeanP1Size3L1W3.cfg from lean/formal/LeanP1Holds1p3b.cfg with the substitutions in lean/formal/results/2026-10-06-ec2/scripts/runner3.sh lines 12–18. Each preparation row records both SHA-256 values.
inputs.Examples: tlaplus/Examples@6a7b26a31c1a6aeec789b455e9bbfa3b3ad2728f, specifications/transaction_commit/{TCommit,TwoPhase}, original same-basename TLA+ and CFG files.
inputs.edits: Start at the published small source and CFG, then two unchanged warm runs. Prepend TRUE /\ to Inv_CitationsLive. For growth, also replace barriers < MaxBarriers by barriers <= MaxBarriers in the Consume guard after s \notin Readers /\ w[s].pc = "idle". Revert the guard, then the property. Each run is a new process.

host.platform: Dedicated c7i.4xlarge, us-east-2b; Intel Xeon Platinum 8488C, 8 physical cores / 16 threads, 32,306,600 KiB RAM; Ubuntu 24.04.5 LTS, Linux 7.0.0-1018-aws
host.affinity: taskset -c 0-7; CPUs 8-15 are sibling threads. Flint 8 workers; Lamport 1.
host.memory: Fresh cgroup v2 per command, peak_bytes is memory.peak for the process and descendants, including charged file pages. wall_s uses CLOCK_MONOTONIC. A peer compilation and its check run inside one cgroup. Preparation and emitted check have separate peaks.
host.compiler: rustc 1.99.0; Core release --locked -p dive-cli --bin dive with CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_LTO=off and CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_CODEGEN_UNITS=16. Pinned peer used its own cargo build --release --locked defaults.

builds.verification: Each prepare row identifies its actual binary, input closure and generator kernel. A discovery bound was added after the timing panel. The independently re-exported 601/40/82-node plans yielded byte-identical generated Rust and shape on all three measured source families. The later scalar-label worker retained the same route on Flint (no scalar label sites); on the Lamport models it carries the positive table/key position into its subsequent write. The final change clears a diagnostic provenance marker when another actor replaces the register. Separate runs retain each actual artifact hash.

commands.prepare: python3 scripts/perf/scale/native-successors/prepare.py MODULE.tla --config CONFIG --cache PRIVATE_CACHE --jobs 8 --profile dive|tlc. Use dive on Flint and tlc on Lamport. Run returned binary, repeat in fresh processes. Cold starts with no bootstrap or worker compilation in the checker cache. Reused preparation takes the current source snapshot, exports its actual generator, and validates the executable manifest.
commands.core: taskset -c 0-7 BINARY check MODULE.tla --config CONFIG --workers W --store fp|exact --fp 0 --seed 0 --max-memory 8g --time-limit 120s --output json. W=8 on Flint, W=1 and --compat=tlc for Lamport.
commands.peer: TLAMC_CACHE=PRIVATE_CACHE tla-mc -compile -config CONFIG -workers W MODULE.tla. Cold begins with an empty peer cache; warm-growth reuses the preceding growth binary despite working-file edits.
commands.controls: python3 scripts/perf/scale/check_native_blocks.py --stock PATH_TO_STOCK_DIVE --cache PRIVATE_CACHE --jobs 8. The script reports exact three-way outcomes in both profiles and checks that forced reclamation and spill actually ran.
commands.traces: For negative words append BarrierBound == barriers = 0, NoBarrierStep == [][barriers' = barriers]_vars, or NotPrepared == \A r \in RM : rmState[r] # "prepared", respectively, and append the appropriate INVARIANT/PROPERTY to the CFG. Use exact store, workers 1/8 and --compat=tlc. Pass word to stock dive validate-trace with the same module/CFG; replace the initial state with the final state and repeat.
commands.coverage: A separate untimed invocation enables DIVE_NATIVE_BLOCK_METER and DIVE_NATIVE_SUCCESSOR_METER with new output paths. Each reported per-operation count is a conservative power-of-two lower bound. One worker at depth limit 10 on Flint, full 1-worker Lamport searches.
commands.disable: DIVE_DISABLE_NATIVE_BLOCKS=1 keeps the old emitted control flow. DIVE_DISABLE_NATIVE_SUCCESSORS=1 selects ordinary Core. Existing fuel, debugger and speculative-candidate gates remain active.

tool_labels.prepare: prepare native-blocks executable for current source/config
tool_labels.tla-mc: pinned compiled peer, same current source and configuration

reading.identity: fp tools compare fingerprints for admitted states. Exact-store rows use Core full-state equality. Every completed Flint row has an empty queue. Qualification uses distinct/generated/depth and checks configured properties.
reading.clocks: The peer combines per-source compilation where needed and a full check. Add prepare and search for user-facing Dive cold or edit cost; an already prepared executable needs only search. Each peak_bytes includes the process tree via cgroup v2. Short transfer timings principally measure startup.
reading.growth: Stock/previous/value-block expansion 42.15/37.10/30.78 s, with level commit 4.69/4.66/4.66 s. Stock/previous/value-block end-to-end 46.90/41.82/35.49 s. These results leave the 22.78 s truly warm compiled peer ahead. Scalar-transfer integration also completed this growth edit in 36.02 s; the corresponding original warm rows were 2.19/2.20 s. The actual optional-meter fix is checked separately.
reading.maintenance: On a property-only edit, 0.223 s rebind + 2.186 s search vs 22.464 s for tla-mc; on a guard changing the graph, 0.225 + 35.494 s vs 43.275 s for the peer to rebuild and run. Both tools reused the previous artifact after undo.
reading.transfer: Separate unmodified Lamport graphs, TCommit 34/94/depth 7 and TwoPhase 288/1146/depth 11, exercise a scalar string-label read and a subsequent update of the verified table and key. Use runs_with_corrected_guard_meter for positive handoff counts. Their millisecond-scale wall times primarily measure startup.
reading.sail: This panel uses the standalone CLI. The earlier source-worker report documents a separate Sail process consuming requests, including whether the optional worker ran. No new Sail result is attributed to this build.
reading.next: Issue #1395 targets shared native value-operator bodies. The pinned peer emits about 185 kB, containing 40–41 named operator bodies and two step-property functions across the original and edits. A point-by-point lowering that does not preserve source sharing had already generated 5.1 MB and failed to beat the control.

cpu_sample_before.qualification: Leaf symbols only; inclusive stacks were incomplete.

design_trials.method: Small engineering trials before the cgroup panel. Fresh process wall in seconds on the same 8-core affinity; these timed iterations use previous intermediate binaries.

sparse_changed_set_cells.qualification: Confirmed changed-cell operations on actual Flint.

generic_nested_read_lowering.decision: Dropped despite over 262,144 actual reads on a depth-10 control.

single_label_on_every_record_and_scalar.decision: Retain direct label-to-write handoff only for scalar label sites, a measured transfer on the two Lamport models. Original Flint uses only record labels, for which the grouped discriminator handles sibling selection.

fault_and_refusal_controls.reason: plan unavailable: exit 3, unsupported, native successor study requires a pure unmapped action plan

fresh_review.checks: Separate Sibling fixtures, before/after multi-field updates, missing keys after a cached guard hit, legitimate duplicate action occurrences, earlier division failure, two-dimensional first-slot-fastest order, changed early exit, and valid vs truncated Bad trace. Two-dimensional control: 49 distinct, 113 generated, depth 5. Independent regeneration bound all three measured executables to the reviewed lowering.
fresh_review.corrected_telemetry: The reviewer identified stale provenance possible when an intervening write replaces the registered actor, then a later write revisits it. The final meter clears the marker whenever the actual cached carrier changes. Independent execution reproduced the old false count of one on writes B,A,A after guarding A; corrected code counted zero. On A,A,A both measured at least two handoffs. Both binaries produced the identical named invariant trace with two distinct/two generated states. The corrected original Lamport sources independently exercised at least 16 and 256 handoffs with unchanged counts and depths.
